question:
Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, and Eve are playing a game. At the start of the game, they are each holding a ball: Alice has a grey ball, Bob has a gold ball, Claire has a silver ball, Dave has a white ball, and Eve has a black ball.
As the game progresses, pairs of players trade balls. First, Bob and Alice swap balls. Then, Alice and Eve swap balls. Then, Alice and Claire swap balls. Then, Eve and Dave swap balls. Finally, Alice and Bob swap balls. At the end of the game, Claire has the
Options:
(A) grey ball
(B) gold ball
(C) silver ball
(D) white ball
(E) black ball
solution:
Ball colors in player order: Alice | Bob | Claire | Dave | Eve.
Initial: grey | gold | silver | white | black
1. Bob ↔ Alice: gold | grey | silver | white | black
2. Alice ↔ Eve: black | grey | silver | white | gold
3. Alice ↔ Claire: silver | grey | black | white | gold
4. Eve ↔ Dave: silver | grey | black | gold | white
5. Alice ↔ Bob: grey | silver | black | gold | white
Claire has the black ball, option (E).
Final answer: (E)
